results.content: **Washington, D.C., October 26, 2026 –** An Ipsos analysis of the October Reuters/Ipsos Core Political survey conducted October 22-26 finds that the Democratic Party holds a 9-point edge over the Republican Party among likely voters on the 2026 generic congressional ballot. Overall, 53% of likely voters say they would vote for or lean to the Democratic candidate in their district, compared with 44% who say they would vote for or lean to the Republican candidate. Among all Americans, just 25% approve of how President Donald Trump is handling the U.S. economy, while only 20% approve of his handling of the cost of living.
